# Registration has closed and the waitlist is now full.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan for this competition](https://drive.google.com/file/d/131RsE16IxwOLL4vNf1Mq-lFQKS6MVNO6/view?usp=sharing).

Please read through the [Judging](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahFall2021#16303-judging) and [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahFall2021#16302-competing) tabs before registering.

Competitors are advised to bring their own pens.

Most competitors will be expected to judge.
